name: VisuPal XR
summary:
VisuPal XR - Bring your digital twins to life in XR!

This companion app for visupal.app/studio lets you stream digital twins from your browser straight to your Meta Quest headset. Create interactive 3D twins from CAD and other formats, connect real-time machine data to animate them, then launch them into XR at the push of a button. Ideal for industry, training, sales and smart visualization.
